summary: Iteration 6 — tested the 3 new/changed surfaces: (1) Admin /api/admin/messaging-settings GET/POST + RBAC + mask + __CLEAR__ sentinel + status/source; (2) /api/admin/analytics aggregation-based payload shape + perf budget + RBAC; (3) /api/cases/{id}/attachments 10MB cap (oversize=413, bad-ext=400, small pdf=200/503). Backend: 23/23 PASS. Frontend Messaging page: login → nav-messaging → fill Twilio → Save → status flips to 'Configured / Source: db' with masked Current: ACf••••890 placeholder → Clear button removes value and disappears. No bugs found.

minor.issue: Endpoint trusts client to send only known keys; arbitrary extra keys won't be persisted since MessagingSettingsIn pydantic model rejects them, but worth a follow-up assertion test in future runs.
Stream cap works but ~10.5MB still accumulates in memory (chunks list) before storage write. Acceptable for 10MB cap; non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/admin.py:_mask — bullet count = len(value)-6 so the masked string echoes the original length, which can leak a weak hint (e.g. SID length). Consider a fixed-width mask like 'ACf••••890'. Non-blocking.

routers/admin.py:set_messaging_settings — raw.items() over model_dump(exclude_none=True) means any field stays None unless sent, which is correct. However `v.strip()` is called on every non-None value but model fields are Optional[str]; if a non-string sneaks through Pydantic guards it would 500. Acceptable since pydantic enforces str.

routers/attachments.py:upload_attachment — file.size hint check exists but FastAPI/Starlette UploadFile.size is often None; the streaming loop is the real defender and works (verified with 11MB random payload → 413).

routers/dashboards.py:admin_analytics — uses $dateFromString on stringified ISO created_at/updated_at; works for current data but if any document has malformed ISO this aggregation will hard-error. Consider $dateFromString errOnNull/onError clauses.

frontend MessagingSettings.jsx — masked value is shown only in the input placeholder; after a Save the input field is cleared (drafts reset). A user might think their value didn't persist unless they read the placeholder. Minor UX nit.
frontend MessagingSettings.jsx — clearField uses window.confirm which can be intercepted by E2E unless an explicit dialog handler is registered; non-blocking, doesn't affect production UX.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 6 roles logged in successfully via /api/auth/login.
seed_data_creation: No new persistent seed data. Twilio creds (TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID/AUTH_TOKEN/FROM) were posted then cleared via __CLEAR__ sentinel inside the same test session — DB state reverted to pre-test on both backend and frontend runs. A small ~64KB pdf attachment was uploaded and then DELETEd by the test for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 introduced /api/admin/messaging-settings (GET masked + POST with __CLEAR__ sentinel), aggregation-based /api/admin/analytics, and a streaming 10MB cap on /api/cases/{id}/attachments. All three pass end-to-end (backend pytest + frontend Playwright). The previous 98/98 regression suite (iterations 1-5) was NOT re-run this round per the main agent's note. db.settings collection will have a doc with _id='messaging' if anyone leaves data behind — tests use __CLEAR__ to clean up. Twilio + WhatsApp remain intentionally unconfigured providers (provider_status both False after cleanup).
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA. Implementation matches spec: _mask returns 'first3+bullets+last3' (verified output 'ACf••••••••••••••••••••••••••••••890'); provider_source returns 'db' when both DB-cached creds present, 'none' when neither DB nor env have them; attachment upload loops `file.read(64*1024)` and raises 413 as soon as `total > MAX_BYTES`. Backend latency for /admin/analytics: <0.5s on current dataset (well under 2.5s budget).
